title: Preserve and authenticate East Siberia assessment inputs and provenance claims from PR #1130
body:
Raised and independently reproduced 2026-10-07 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected PR #1130, merge `90d5309c6497073a039099241360ba807d0c3722`, head `55f9cb8af674ea6992435bcb7df020a7d80910e5`. Original #393 is closed and its historical packet must remain intact. One additive geography erratum PR in the new disjoint namespace below; no production or geometry edits.

Independently confirmed defects in `data/regional-review/regional-review-5cf69eed7fdff0b5/reproduction/`:
1. `analyze-geography.py` reads current metadata key `source_level`; the pinned features actually store `administrative_level`. All207 assessment `current_source_level` values are null and all207 subject table source-level claims are blank despite present pinned administrative-level claims. This loses the provenance claim being reviewed. Report the actual field faithfully while clearly distinguishing a source's claim from approved geographic semantics.
2. The actual science entry point consumes scope-inventory fields without authenticating them or binding them to pinned feature fields. A complete207-subject inventory changing only `gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B10017540039169` current_name from `Mukhorshibirsky Rayon` to `AUDITOR WRONG PINNED NAME` is accepted. Output publishes that fabricated name while `current_name_matches_source` remains true because the flag compares different, actual feature/source names. Fixture191855B, SHA256 `b758b5c444e43724f124acf2592168dec345b697183c56d5546dc7fab33a461a`. This is an actual input-binding false positive; the committed historical name itself is correct.
3. Actual science and table-renderer final writes unconditionally replace their existing output files. The documented default paths target retained historical assessment/table. Against two owned private sentinel outputs, both actual mains succeed and replace both with456707B assessment and137185B table. The Auditor never ran these writes against retained originals.

Actual reproduction: managed sparse detached exact-merge checkout, cached Python3.12.14/Shapely2.1.2/GEOS3.13.1/pyproj3.7.2, Node24, no installations or source hydration. Inspect both scripts before execution. Execute actual science main then actual renderer main twice using a reviewed private adapter that redirects only the two final output writers and their generated-output read/stat/hash aliases. All parsing, source hash checks, joins, geometry comparisons and formatting remain original. Both products match each other and retained originals byte-for-byte: assessment SHA256 `6da1c9850f0c5bec64061db4fdf06577df475355d5e6f9cb7c233412b665477d`; table SHA256 `f274cde0d43f108971425c2c09b2c75b126a924cf82b48756bfd968ecb253744`. For the inventory drift control additionally redirect only that inventory read to the complete fixture; no geometry/source or code changes. For overwrite control use two private preexisting sentinel files. Preserve versioned adapter and failure records: initial auditor write-guard/indentation failures were corrected in a separately reviewed adapter version and are not evidence that the original producer refuses existing outputs. Final actual overwrite run exits0 and produces both exact retained outputs.

Independent numerical/source checks: all23 added whole files50660511B and all17 descriptor bindings match. Two actual scope replays match retained225036B output and authenticate all36 indexed baseline parts. Exact207 subjects, six parents,185 direct native joins and22 overlays checked. Independent explicit WGS84 equal-area formulas/topological comparisons reproduce1480 direct and132 overlay/support values (1612 total), maximum relative errors1.74e-12 and2.27e-13 respectively. Native JavaScript hashes independently authenticate all193 retained direct/support feature objects. Actual producer-function controls return identical IoU1, half IoU0.5, disjoint0; diagnostic repair leaves invalid original unchanged. These positive results do not excuse the three integrity defects.

Success criteria:
- Add a fresh erratum/reproducer under the declared namespace; preserve all original source/geometry/IDs/names/parentage/dates/scripts/output files and issue history. Keep exact207 subjects and six parent rows.
- Report the actual pinned administrative-level claim for every subject, with explicit source-claim/approval separation. Independently compare all207 output cells to pinned metadata; no invented legal classification.
- Before using data or emitting results, authenticate actual complete scope/source/code/current-part/hierarchy bytes against independently established pins; validate unique exact identities and every consumed name/parent/source-member join. Reject the actual complete name-drift fixture, identity/parent/duplicate/missing-member/code/source drift via the real entry point before success. Do not merely record a new hash after consuming it.
- Admit the complete fresh output set before any write; reject existing file/directory/broken-symlink/path-escape/partial-conflict cases without changing existing bytes. Actual default entry points must not overwrite historical packets.
- Execute two genuine fresh complete actual runs, compare all complete products, retain independent positive and nonvacuous negative controls and failed-attempt evidence. Missing/failed/mismatched runs cannot produce a passed reproducibility receipt. Preserve1612 numerical results on original inputs (tolerance explicitly justified),185 insufficient-evidence and22 correction-needed dispositions; only supported provenance-field corrections may differ.
- Provide a version1 evidence manifest with exact subjects, whole-file hashes, actual consumed-input/method/control identities, metric bindings, pair receipts and original-preservation evidence.

Limits/dependencies: this bounded mechanical correction requires no restored120489189B raw Russia source and does not authenticate its185+8 extraction lineage. Constitution Article65 dated text and Rosstat actual primary content remain unverified; existing #1125/#1126/#1133 own administrative suitability, ecology/water semantics and2327/2328 source-count questions. Do not certify legal geography, adjudicate boundaries, import, publish or expand their scope. Empty dependencies are intentional: all required bounded mechanical inputs are already retained. Run global scope and focused science as separately budgeted phases; no oversized raw-file cap bypass.

Deduplication: complete all-state discovery14 pages/938 non-PR issues and later affected-packet Git history found no matching mechanical repair. #1151 covers different Turkey/Slovenia programs and subjects. Existing #1125/#1126/#1133 cover different source/semantic questions and remain separate. Maximum one PR; shared readiness must independently review exact scope, ownership, dependencies and evidence before Ready.
